assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: albedo texture of one wooden window shutter leaf, mapped onto a flat rectangular board.
Primary request: a painted louvered wooden shutter seen straight on, filling the entire image edge to edge with no wall or background. A narrow outer frame, about twelve horizontal slats, one middle rail.
Palette: neutral off-white and very light warm grey paint only, with soft grey shading between slats, so the game can tint it to any colour. No coloured paint.

Avoid: perspective, wall, window, hinges, text, borders, vignette, colour tints. One opaque RGB image.
